## About
Merc-Werks is an independent Mercedes-Benz shop in Pompano Beach. We're race enthusiasts with a performance background, and we look after everyday maintenance as well as performance needs. The goal is dealer quality at consumer pricing.
We handle Mercedes-Benz A-Service and B-Service, AC service, electrical repair, oil and filter changes, transmission flushes and brakes. Call or email to set up an appointment, and ask us for a quote before any work starts.
Customers rate us 4.8 from 137 Google reviews. We're open Monday through Friday and closed on weekends.

## Services
- Mercedes-Benz A-Service: Brake component inspection, fluid level checks, tire inflation check and correction, maintenance counter reset, oil filter replacement and synthetic motor oil. You get a detailed report of what we found and what we changed. Call for a quote.
- Deep diagnostic work: When a problem is hard to pin down, we run a deep diagnostic. One reviewer said it helped figure out all of the problems with their car.
- Oil and filter change: Routine oil and filter service for your Mercedes.
- Complimentary visual health check: Call the shop to set up a no-charge visual check of your car.

## FAQ
Q: Do you work on older Mercedes models?
A: Yes. One reviewer wrote that Rolston and his team handle both modern and classic Mercedes.

Q: What kind of parts do you use?
A: One longtime customer noted that all parts used on their cars were original.

Q: How do I book an appointment?
A: Call or email the shop to set up a time. We're open Monday through Friday.
